name: Residence for Private Reasons (Durable Partnership / Personal Ties)

requirements.blocker_text: Applicant must show stable, long-standing, and strong personal or family ties to a person legally residing in Luxembourg. For unmarried partnerships, neither partner may be married or in a registered partnership with anyone else.
The person in Luxembourg must hold Luxembourg nationality or have held legal residence status for at least 1 year, and provide a signed financial-support statement.
Applicant must have stable, regular and sufficient resources at least equal to the social inclusion income (REVIS), without recourse to social assistance.
Proof of suitable housing in Luxembourg required (rental agreement, property deed, or similar).

evidence_required.document: Evidence of the personal/family relationship's duration and stability

outcome.duration_length: up to 3 years, renewable; long-term resident status available after 5 years of lawful uninterrupted residence

sources.title: Guichet.lu -- Conditions of Residence in Luxembourg for Private Reasons for Third-Country Nationals: stable personal/family ties standard, sponsor requirements, REVIS-based income test, housing proof, up to 3-year permit

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Luxembourg). This is the route for unmarried durable partners and other close personal/family ties NOT covered by formal spouse/registered-partner family reunification (lu_family_reunification.json) -- a genuinely distinct legal basis under Luxembourg immigration law (residence 'for private reasons' vs. formal 'family reunification'). work_rights modeled 'restricted' since the source did not explicitly confirm unrestricted labour-market access on this specific permit type -- flagged as a conservative default, not confirmed either way.
